create_ActivationWatcher: create an ActivationWatcher instance to monitor input activations in a PyTorch model's layers
watch_activations: watch and collect input activations from all or specific layers of a model using a data loader
save_activations: save collected layer activations to a file using torch.save for later analysis
get_layers: get a list of all non-BatchNorm2d layer names from a PyTorch model's state dict
get_bn_layers: get a list of all BatchNorm2d layer names from a PyTorch model's state dict
